description: A JSON object by authority with objects
authorityName: name of issuing authority, such as HMRC or Companies House. UK is the default.
validateUsingIdentifierScheme: Flag to determine whether or not to run Companies House validations based on identifer scheme.
validateUsingIdentifierSchemeOverride: Flag override to specifically use base validations or base + CoHo validations.

default.comment: Base HMRC validations where regulator specific validations are decided by the entity ID

companieshouse.comment: Base HMRC validations + Companies House validations
